title: Rendezvous

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Oh! Hey! You made it. Quite the spot, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh! Hey! You made it. Quite the spot, right?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: You do? Can't blame 'em. Where's their favorite spot? Unless it's a secret, though I can keep a secret you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do? Can't blame 'em. Where's their favorite spot? Unless it's a secret, though I can keep a secret you know.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Ah, nothing beats the water. Before the debt came tumbling down, I used to dream about this place on Calypso Island. Have you ever been?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, nothing beats the water. Before the debt came tumbling down, I used to dream about this place on Calypso Island. Have you ever been?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Oh, for one, my cousin Jay - hey! I see what you tried to do there. Not gonna pull one over on me! Haha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, for one, my cousin Jay - hey! I see what you tried to do there. Not gonna pull one over on me! Haha.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I've only been once, when I was young. We took a family trip to celebrate my older sister's certification. Hmph, that was such a great trip. There for a full three days. Neither of us had been out of the main city 'side from a boat trip.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've only been once, when I was young. We took a family trip to celebrate my older sister's certification. Hmph, that was such a great trip. There for a full three days. Neither of us had been out of the main city 'side from a boat trip.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Ah, people always think that until they're the only ones still hanging around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, people always think that until they're the only ones still hanging around.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Oh that was the first of many things. She got a certification in grafting, then she got one that made her an expert in ocular tattooing, and I don't know what else. I stopped paying attention after she left for Luna, some intense training camp on the nuances of granite harvesting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh that was the first of many things. She got a certification in grafting, then she got one that made her an expert in ocular tattooing, and I don't know what else. I stopped paying attention after she left for Luna, some intense training camp on the nuances of granite harvesting.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: No one to talk to. Only one still left around is my sister and she's still on Luna. Never came back when Mom was sick. Never helped with the debt or assets - ha, that's such a funny word.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one to talk to. Only one still left around is my sister and she's still on Luna. Never came back when Mom was sick. Never helped with the debt or assets - ha, that's such a funny word.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Yeah, think about it. Assets are the things you have that have value, right? The word literally starts with ass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, think about it. Assets are the things you have that have value, right? The word literally starts with ass.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Like the things that you think have value actually make you an asshole!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like the things that you think have value actually make you an asshole!

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Ah, I'd like to blame it on a lack of Lims. But, truth be told, don't think I can. Afraid if I do, the new memory will replace the old one and I really don't want that to happen. I miss those relationships and would hate to have the memory masked, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, I'd like to blame it on a lack of Lims. But, truth be told, don't think I can. Afraid if I do, the new memory will replace the old one and I really don't want that to happen. I miss those relationships and would hate to have the memory masked, you know?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: If you don't sell your soul, sure. Look at those flashing ad boards and shit though... Most would sell their very skin to see their face on one of those.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you don't sell your soul, sure. Look at those flashing ad boards and shit though... Most would sell their very skin to see their face on one of those.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: One-hundred-fucking-percent. Haha, grimy bastards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One-hundred-fucking-percent. Haha, grimy bastards.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Ah, I guess it could be worse. You know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, I guess it could be worse. You know?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Yeah, guess you bring it out of me. This was fun. Have to do it again some time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, guess you bring it out of me. This was fun. Have to do it again some time.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: There are the struggles. Though this was fun. We'll have to do it again some time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are the struggles. Though this was fun. We'll have to do it again some time.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I like the gardens. I feel like this is the most natural place in Nivalis, yah know? Only other place would be the islands.
